Name: Chickens to Parrots
Author: gizomo
Description:
Hello! I love parrots. I've been a bit sad that there weren't any parrot-related mods here, until I discovered [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33928290]Ankokou[/url]'s lovely [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/309]Bird Replacments[/url] mod. Still, that's for your own children, not for your livestock! Though I think there is a cockatiel -> chicken mod out there, too... Anyway, I was inspired by Eemie's Toucan and Cardinal mods, but I was a little disappointed that there was nothing encompassing all my fowl.

So I went and drew some myself. This will replace the White Chicken with a Sulfur Cockatoo, the Brown Chicken with the Scarlet Macaw, the Blue Chicken with a Hyacinth Macaw, and the Void Chicken with a Palm Cockatoo.

[u]How to install:[/u]
Backup your chicken.xnb (Blue, Brown, White, and Void) files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals, then extract this mod into the same location.

[u]Update 1.2:
[/u]- Well, thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50086141]Esodra[/url] for helping me by making the baby versions! You are ever so sweet. 

- I've also included an optional file for Shane which changes Charlie into a cockatoo. I initially used a (shittily) modified version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/329]MIMI's portraits[/url].  But, I realized that people might want other versions, so I created four others - the original, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/97]Bunni's[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/391]Kal's[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888]DCBurger's[/url]. My little cockatoo is not hi-res enough to make the hi-res version, however.

Downloads.Description: This contains all four parrots. Change the names around if you want!
